submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 at a 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency at the allowed 8 kHz trigger rate, based on direct simulation and corroborated by previous emulation results. It meets all deployment criteria and outperforms the alternatives across the valid threshold range.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: All three candidates fit within FPGA resource budget as specified in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV achieves over 91% signal efficiency while staying within the allocated 8 kHz according to simulation and previous emulation studies.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Single, clear recommendation submitted: Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV.
